description: See frames of the user's video as small pictures: one at at_ms, or up to 6 spread evenly from from_ms to to_ms. Use it to see what happens in a part, not to time single strokes. Only works after the user turns on Let my AI see video frames.

at_ms.description: Start of the time range in milliseconds on the video timeline.
at_ms.title: At Ms

editor_code.description: The editor code the user reads from the editor's AI panel under Your own AI, for example K7P4QX. Leave it out when connected with the account address.
editor_code.title: Editor Code

from_ms.description: Start of the time range in milliseconds on the video timeline.
from_ms.title: From Ms

to_ms.description: End of the time range in milliseconds.
to_ms.title: To Ms

name: look_at_video
title: Look at video
